title: nepeta amethystina var. boissieri
intro: Nepeta amethystina var. boissieri, commonly known as Catmint, is a perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family, characterized by its attractive spikes of blue-purple flowers. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Nepeta amethystina var. boissieri include its sedative, spasmolytic, and diuretic effects, which can aid in reducing stress, promoting relaxation, and supporting urinary health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in traditional medicine.
